status: Expanded source-label exploratory analysis; not a 600-patient validated classifier
label_rule: Original source PH labels; 22 conflicting plus 1 weak identity merge held; no pressure threshold relabeling
COPD_rule: Source etiology/CT diagnosis attribution; GOLD absent/-1/0 retained as unknown severity; not independent COPD adjudication

CV.preprocessing: Training-fold imputation/scaling/encoding only; no resampling, no supervised feature filtering
CV.patient_isolation: All available strong source patient keys checked for uniqueness; same folds across models
CV.RF: fixed 200 trees, max_depth3, min_samples_leaf5, class_weight balanced_subsample
CV.XGB: fixed 150 trees, max_depth2, eta0.03, subsample0.8, colsample0.8, reg_lambda10; training-fold imbalance weight

uncertainty: Repeat min/max are partition variability, not confidence intervals; no external test set
forbidden_predictors: source/CT protocol except explicitly diagnostic or adjusted models
feature_definition: Five original measured CT fields frozen in prior pilot; no outcome-based feature selection
date_rule: Use audited original-yu CT/RHC dates; allow documented terminal-colon removal only, never infer missing century. Original raw date and normalization retained in evidence.
